title: aruncus dioicus f. tomentosus
intro: Aruncus dioicus f. tomentosus, commonly known as woolly goat's beard, is a variant of the flowering plant Aruncus dioicus with a distinctive woolly texture. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits such as soothing inflammation and reducing anxiety. The therapeutic actions of woolly goat's beard include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties, which may help to calm the nervous system and relieve muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic effects.
